g.text: Illustrative dynamics on a seeded peer network. Every stance change is traceable to the posts a participant saw.
a seeded peer network: each participant links to 6 peers by
Jaccard overlap of interest ids, about 75% within its own
Each round, r = 1 to N (N at most 5); completed rounds are skipped on resume
a seeded active_share acts in this round
up to feed_size items from network neighbours: their
interview answers in round 1, their latest posts first in
10 participants per call; each returns an action (post,

posts and current stances; the round summary counts
stance shifts; idempotent by round index
In round 2 a participant sees two neighbour posts,
moves from mixed to positive, and gives a reason.
Its post stores both stances, the reason, and the ids
of the two posts it saw.
